crossRefs.note: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

translations.web: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
translations.bsb: Righteous lips are a king’s delight, and he who speaks honestly is beloved.
translations.kjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
translations.asv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; And they love him that speaketh right.
